name: 24866-audiotranscribe-whisperlargev3-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: WhisperForConditionalGeneration encoder-decoder: encoder 32 layers, decoder 32 layers, d_model 1280, 20 heads (head_dim 64), 128 mel bins, vocab 51866, max_target_positions 448, float16, ~1.55B params (from the checkpoint's config.json).
load_profile: Concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded at 400 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, first 10% warmup by completion.
workload: Speech-to-text transcription, single turn, one audio clip per request and no text on the wire: `openslr/librispeech_asr` config `clean` split `test` (2620 read-speech utterances, ~7.4 s mean, ~350 MB) through guidellm's `hf` deserializer, with the column mapping pinned to `{audio_column: audio}` so the dataset's reference transcript in its `text` column is never handed to the engine as a prompt; the decoder prompt is Whisper's task prefix `<|startoftranscript|><|en|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>` (the backend appends a newline), output is pinned at exactly 200 tokens with `ignore_eos`, greedy (temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0), and 400 requests against 2620 clips means the dataset never wraps.
purpose: A speech-to-text service transcribing short English audio clips for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: openai/whisper-large-v3
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 448
